evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says: 'This should take about, let's say ten to fifteen minutes and then we'll be able to, to build an accurate estimate. Is that okay?' — time-boxed and promise of accurate estimate present, but rushes past after customer agrees without a real pause or reconfirmation of readiness.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks: 'Aside from the price or rates, what are your biggest concerns for this upcoming move and you know, what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?' — but this is asked AFTER initial discovery probing has already begun (addresses, floor info, square footage already collected).
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer states: 'Nothing really, primarily really want to get the rate.' No concerns were raised, so N/A.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep collects: pickup address (8818 Travis Drive, Austin 78735), floor (3rd to 2nd), apartment size (1200 sq ft, moving to 1370–1400 sq ft 3-bed), elevator access (no), walking distances (stairs on both ends, ~30–35 feet to unit), special items (75-inch TV, stationary bike, wooden dresser, crib), furniture inventory (couch, loveseat, coffee table, dining table, 2 beds, 4 nightstands, 1 dresser), dropoff address (Building 5, Unit 522, same complex), and box count estimate (25 boxes). All seven logistics items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep asks: 'So now for the packing services, so you need help in packing the kitchen stuff, the wardrobe, and then the rest of the small miscellaneous items, is that correct?' — packing services confirmed.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep states: 'For a two bedroom apartment usually has 25 to 35 boxes. So do you feel like you will fall within that range?' — box count discussed and confirmed at 25 boxes.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives: 'So for the complete packing and the moving service... we recommend budgeting around $2,632. That's for the packing and for the moving. And this estimate includes approximately $217 in packing supplies.' Also personalizes: '10:00 to eleven hours' based on 3rd floor with stairs, full packing, 2-day breakdown (5.5 hrs day one packing, 6 hrs day two move). Both range and personalization present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep mentions: 'This estimate includes approximately $217 in packing supplies. So we bring all the materials necessary and only charge you for the materials actually.' — packing supplies disclosed, but no mention of trip fee, overnight fee, 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments, or 'not a guess' framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent. No pause offered for customer reaction to pricing.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Not mentioned anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Not mentioned anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No closing of Section 5 promises occurred because neither promise was delivered.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep never asks 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or a genuine equivalent. Call ends after estimate is stated.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or similar catch-all.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any recognizable version of an explicit ask for the business. Call ends with estimate statement.

top_strength: The rep did thorough logistics probing and gathered nearly all required details (addresses, floor info, special items, furniture inventory, dropoff location, box count, and packing service needs) in a methodical, well-organized way that built an accurate estimate.
coaching_note: The call ended after giving the price with no closing: no 'Does that feel fair?' pause, no Two Promises section, no final concerns check, and no explicit ask for the business — the rep needs to complete all seven sections, not stop at the estimate.
booking_note: Estimate was provided ($2,632) and October 18th was tentatively selected, but the customer never explicitly agreed to book the move. The call ends after the estimate is presented with no confirmation of booking or next steps.
